title: Monkey wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- party hat -->
  <polygon points='50,6 36,30 64,30' fill='#ff3b6b'/>
  <polygon points='50,6 44,18 56,18' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <polygon points='44,18 38,30 56,30 50,18' fill='#3ec9ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='6' r='4' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='24' ry='21' fill='#a05a2c'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='25' cy='44' r='8' fill='#a05a2c'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='44' r='8' fill='#a05a2c'/>
  <circle cx='25' cy='44' r='4' fill='#e8a06a'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='44' r='4' fill='#e8a06a'/>
  <!-- face patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='17' ry='14' fill='#f0c08a'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='44' r='4.5' fill='#2b1a0e'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='44' r='4.5' fill='#2b1a0e'/>
  <circle cx='43.5' cy='42.5' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59.5' cy='42.5' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#7a3f1c'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M42 59 Q50 66 58 59' fill='none' stroke='#7a3f1c' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='17' ry='15' fill='#a05a2c'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='11' ry='10' fill='#f0c08a'/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='76' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#a05a2c' transform='rotate(-25 27 76)'/>
  <ellipse cx='73' cy='76' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#a05a2c' transform='rotate(25 73 76)'/>
</svg>
